name: student-management-system
description: Student Management System — MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node), runs fully locally

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix server run test:coverage && npm --prefix client run test:coverage
scripts.audit: npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
